summary: Card skimming devices were found at 13 7-Eleven, Inc. locations in Fairfax County, Virginia, during 'Operation Skim Scam', a December 2025 sweep by Fairfax County Police and the US Secret Service that inspected point-of-sale terminals, ATMs and gas pumps at more than 100 sites and recovered 20 skimmers at nearly 20 locations (including 7-Eleven, Dollar Tree, Fresh World and Americana Grocery stores).
